target_customer: Startups and small to mid sized companies looking for office space; revenue paid by landlords as broker commission
problem: Finding and leasing small, short term or shared office space is slow because inventory is fragmented across landlords and brokers.
business_model: Brokerage commission paid by landlord on signed leases, free to tenants

founders.name: Rafi Sands
education: Stanford (researched post-COVID office market under Professor Nick Bloom, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a 20-time marathon runner and former Guinness record holder. Degrees and employers not confirmed on a page I opened.

founders.name: Brendan Suh
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no further background.

technical_complexity.rationale: A search and workflow layer over listings with an AI co-pilot is standard web and LLM engineering; the hard part is inventory and operations, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregated inventory and broker relationships help, but traditional brokers and new entrants can copy the model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing incumbent response; the company says traditional brokers focus on large long term spaces.

market_need_then: YC page and company copy say traditional brokerage serves big long term leases well, while smaller, short term and shared space is hard to find; post-COVID office demand shifted, and Sands researched that at Stanford.

branding.domain_note: Uses tandemspace.com, not an exact tandem.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and startup oriented; phrases like 'Move faster' and 'Sign with confidence'.

brand_strength.rationale: A search found no press about the brand itself; the common word name needed a 'Space' suffix for its domain and is easy to confuse with other Tandem companies.

outcome_analysis: Tandem is an active Summer 2024 company that raised a 6.1M seed in February 2025 including an earlier 750K pre-seed, and operates in New York, San Francisco and Boston. No negative outcome news was found. Its path depends on turning AI search into broker economics against established commercial brokerages.
notes: Seed amount reported by Axios (headline), citybiz and another outlet; the investor list comes from the press release as relayed, the Axios page was paywalled. The 6.1M seed (announced February 4, 2025) includes the 750K pre-seed closed in 2023, per the company press release as relayed by Baker City Herald, so the separate pre-seed round entry was removed to avoid double counting. Client counts differ (750, 500, 300 across sources). Founder degrees and Bain or Pano employment appeared only on an aggregator profile, so they are not recorded. Competitor search found no dated 2023 to 2024 competitor coverage, so the list is empty.
